definitions.samples: 3 independent browser/context cold-warm pairs per condition; 12 startups; no discarded samples; alternating condition order
definitions.cold: Fresh browser/context; every runtime resource reports positive transferSize; OS/DNS/CDN and machine code caches not controlled
definitions.warm: New page and worker in primed context; all five runtime resource transferSize zero and body sizes positive
definitions.readiness: Unchanged navigation-to-first-successful-probe boundary, 30s startup safety and 2s evaluation deadline
definitions.fsInit: Documented hook before main/interpreter start, empty site-packages guaranteed; not an exact WASM completion or Python initialization duration
definitions.resources: Worker and page time origins recorded separately; Resource Timing fetch spans overlap initialization/streaming compilation, not additive CPU phases
definitions.loopback: Identical decoded pinned assets freshly downloaded and SHA256 recorded, local gzip, experimental indexURL only; not a production hosting switch or CDN compression comparison
definitions.cpu: Per-logical-CPU cumulative times and load averages before/after each startup; shared-host load, power, uplink uncontrolled

unobservable: Exact Python interpreter initialization versus Pyodide bootstrap
